answer: A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 400 keys live and online for the whole period, so that the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Rotation is logged in the vertex index and the ripple audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the hollow beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
